name: 紅腳田雞
illustrationTaxon: Zapornia akool adult (eastern Z. a. coccinipes form for the regional range); sexes alike, female slightly smaller

similarSpecies.distinction: 上體較深冷、栗紅下體範圍大；腳橙紅而嘴帶綠，本種腳深紫紅、嘴灰黑配黃綠嘴基。
體型明顯較小、上體有白斑及暗色三級飛羽；脅部有黑白橫斑，本種脅部素色無橫斑。

featureNotes: 灰黑嘴配黃綠色嘴基（第1圈實際可見）。
喉部淡白而不明顯，與橄欖灰下體相接（第2圈實際可見）。
素色橄欖褐背翼，脅部無黑白橫斑（第3圈實際可見；折翼狀態）。
深紫紅色腿及特大長趾（第4圈實際可見）。

rangeMap.note: Country overview only: nominate resident from east Pakistan through India to Bangladesh and west Burma; eastern Z. a. coccinipes in northeast Vietnam and southeast China including HK. More northerly birds are migratory, which the single-season country map does not show.

sources.use: HKBWS substantive identification/range/conservation read: 26-28cm, plain olive-brown above and olive-grey below with indistinct whitish throat, deep pinkish-purple legs, yellow/green base to bill, very large feet; sexes alike; resident Pakistan/India/Bangladesh/west Burma and Z.a. coccinipes NE Vietnam/SE China; LC, trend unknown.
